description: Infrastructures de recharge pour (IRVE) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agglomération Montargoise Et rives du loing. These data make it possible to locate and know the technical characteristics of stations and recharging points for electric vehicles open to the public, belonging to the Communauté d’Agglomération Montargoise and located on its territory. These stations and recharging points are part of the E-totem network (more information on the website e-totem.fr). Coverage: Agglomération Montargoise Et rives du loing. The portal shows the English title as "Charging infrastructure for electric vehicles (IRVE)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Agglomération Montargoise Et rives du loing. Its keywords include mobilite, loiret, vehicule-electrique, borne-electrique, agglomeration-montargoise, deplacement. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2024-12-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
